title: Quality-gate failure record (build-failure)
description: Appended by feature-implementer when the quality gate (./gradlew build && ./gradlew test && ./gradlew checkJavaFormat) fails. The coordinator reads the latest build-failure record per req_id to decide between retry (retry < 3) and system-design-expert escalation (retry == 3). Append-only; failures are not deleted on success — instead, a build-pass record is appended so the retry trail survives in the file.

retry.description: Retry counter for this design cycle. 1 on the first failure, increments on each subsequent failure. Resets to 1 after a fresh design-block record (whether the original or a re-triage record with supersedes_record_at set).

failed_check.description: Which step of the quality gate failed.

error_output.description: Full error output from the failing command. Multi-line strings are fine; JSONL preserves newlines as \n.

attempted.description: Brief description of the change the implementer made before the failure surfaced.

partial.description: Optional flag set by the implementer when this record is a partial-artifact handoff (the dispatch reached its toolCallBudget before the quality gate ran). When true, the error_output field carries a progress description (which tests pass, which files have been edited, which acceptance criteria remain) rather than a failure description. The retry counter still ticks; the existing build-failure recovery path routes the next dispatch with the partial-artifact context. Absent or false records carry the pre-requirement meaning (quality-gate failure).
